cases.symptom: Adding IP address or route fails with 'RTNETLINK answers: File exists'
cases.root_cause: The IP address or static route already exists in the kernel routing/address table.
cases.verified_fix: Use `ip addr replace <ip>/<cidr> dev <iface>` or `ip route replace <subnet> via <gw>` instead of `add`, or inspect existing entries with `ip addr show` / `ip route show`.

cases.error_pattern: Error: Nexthop has invalid gateway|Network is unreachable
cases.symptom: Adding a route fails with 'Nexthop has invalid gateway' or 'Network is unreachable'
cases.root_cause: The gateway IP is not on any directly connected L2 subnet (no local interface has an IP in the same subnet as the gateway).
cases.verified_fix: First assign a local interface IP in the gateway's subnet (`sudo ip addr replace <local_ip>/<mask> dev <iface>` and `sudo ip link set <iface> up`) OR add an onlink route (`sudo ip route replace <subnet> via <gw> dev <iface> onlink`).

cases.symptom: tio --script fails with Lua syntax error or hangs on Python syntax
cases.root_cause: `tio --script` uses Lua inside tio, NOT Python! Passing `import time` or Python code breaks tio.
cases.verified_fix: Use valid Lua syntax inside `tio --script`: e.g. `expect('login: ', 5000); write('root\r\n'); expect('# ', 5000); write('ip addr\r\n'); sleep(1); exit()` or use `python3 -c 'import serial...'` instead.

cases.symptom: ICMP ping shows 100% packet loss or Destination Host Unreachable
cases.root_cause: Target host blocks ICMP, lacks a return route back to our source IP, or L2 ARP resolution failed (`INCOMPLETE` / `FAILED`).
cases.verified_fix: 1. Check `ip neigh show` to see if ARP resolved a MAC address (if MAC is present, host is alive at L2!). 2. Check `sudo iptables -t nat -L -n -v` to ensure MASQUERADE is enabled if routing across subnets. 3. Probe TCP ports (`nmap -Pn -p 22,80,443 <ip>`).

cases.root_cause: The target host is reachable at L3, but no service is listening on that TCP port or a local firewall rejected the SYN packet.

cases.symptom: curl exits with code 28 (Connection timed out)
cases.root_cause: Packets are being silently dropped (DROP firewall policy, missing NAT MASQUERADE return path, or wrong routing table entry).
cases.verified_fix: Check `ip route get <target_ip>`, verify ARP table `ip neigh show`, and add `--connect-timeout 5 --max-time 10` to curl.

cases.error_pattern: Permission denied \(publickey|Host key verification failed|no matching host key type
cases.symptom: SSH connection fails with exit code 255
cases.root_cause: Strict host key checking, legacy SSH algorithms on embedded router/device, or missing credentials.
cases.verified_fix: For embedded/legacy devices, use `ssh -o StrictHostKeyChecking=no -o UserKnownHostsFile=/dev/null -o HostKeyAlgorithms=+ssh-rsa,ssh-dss <user>@<ip>`.

cases.symptom: Shell returns exit code 127 (command not found)
cases.root_cause: The requested binary is not installed or is in `/sbin` / `/usr/sbin` outside non-root PATH.
cases.verified_fix: Check `which <cmd>` or `/usr/sbin/<cmd>`, or use standard POSIX/iproute2 equivalents (`ip`, `ss`, `python3`).

cases.error_pattern: is not recognized as an internal or external command|is not recognized as the name of a cmdlet
cases.symptom: Windows CMD or PowerShell reports command/cmdlet is not recognized
cases.root_cause: A Linux command was run on Windows, or a PowerShell cmdlet was invoked inside `cmd.exe` without `powershell -NoProfile -Command`.
cases.verified_fix: On Windows, use `powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "<cmdlet>"` or native Windows tools (`ipconfig /all`, `route print`, `arp -a`, `netstat -ano`, `curl.exe`).

cases.error_pattern: Access is denied|requires elevation|Operation not permitted
cases.symptom: Command fails with 'Access is denied', 'requires elevation', or 'Operation not permitted'
cases.root_cause: Modifying network routes, firewall rules, or protected ACLs requires Administrator (Windows) or root/sudo (Linux) privileges.
cases.verified_fix: Use `sudo <cmd>` on Linux, an elevated Administrator shell on Windows, or non-privileged read-only inspection (`ip route show`, `route print`, `whoami /priv`).

cases.error_pattern: running scripts is disabled on this system|PSSecurityException|AuthorizationManager check failed
cases.symptom: PowerShell blocks script execution due to ExecutionPolicy
cases.root_cause: Windows PowerShell Restricted execution policy blocks `.ps1` scripts by default.

cases.error_pattern: Command completed with exit code 0|Disconnected|Device or resource busy|Resource temporarily unavailable|Input/output error|console.*drop|too many commands
cases.symptom: Serial console (/dev/ttyUSB0) drops connection, freezes, or returns 0 bytes ('Command completed with exit code 0') when bombarded with rapid or chained commands
cases.root_cause: Hardware UART RX FIFO buffer overrun or rapid DTR/RTS port cycling caused by sending multiple commands without character/line pacing (-o/-O) or opening /dev/ttyUSB0 back-to-back.
cases.verified_fix: Use hardware UART pacing `-o 15 -O 120` and send ONLY ONE command per session: `tio -b 115200 -o 15 -O 120 --mute --script-run once --script 'write("\r"); msleep(500); write("id\r"); while read(4096, 600) > 0 do end; exit(0)' /dev/ttyUSB0`.
